dict.string: Penpal uses the camera to import physical notebook pages, ask about external photos, or provide video to an interactive block only after you approve that block.
Penpal accesses your selected photos when you import a notebook page, trace an image, or ask about a photo.
Penpal saves exported note images and PDFs to your photo library when you choose to save them.
Penpal uses the microphone when you dictate a question or math problem, and for an interactive block only after you approve that block.
Penpal uses speech recognition to transcribe spoken questions and math problems onto your page.
Penpal lets an interactive block use your location only after you approve that block.
